query:
Which member made the original argument that the group should stick to known reliable pubs for the reunion, arguing specifically that unfamiliar venues create problems and things always go wrong?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Callum
C. Omar
D. Dev
context:

[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:21:00) alright everyone glad Saturday landed well. we did actually talk about the reunion a bit, so summary: people want something that feels like more of an event this year. sat 21st March looking like the frontrunner for date. lmk if there's an issue
[8] (about=Temi, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:13:00) okay so I've been thinking about this since Saturday. the dinner worked because the room was right. we were actually talking, not shouting. the gallery beforehand set a tone that a pub never would have. I think what we proved is that the format matters as much as who shows up.
[9] (about=Dev, episodic, t0 @2026-01-05T19:15:00) gallery then pub. truly a team building experience. love that for us
[10] (about=Jade, episodic, t6 @2026-01-26T19:43:00) Marcus can I just say you and Temi writing the group invite is the correct move. remember when we did the school magazine last issue and you two ended up editing each other's edits for a week. do not let that happen again 😂
[11] (about=Jade, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:33:00) Dev just admitted Omar had a good idea. put it in the archives Temi!! 😂 also yes, same group more or less, please. this size was right.
[12] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:31:00) Omar actually sorted the logistics himself. I'm genuinely impressed 😄 in, obviously. lmk if there's an issue with the pitch booking
[13] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:35:00) Saturday was the best-attended event in two years and we did an escape room. I'll admit I would not have predicted that. good shout Jade.
[14] (about=Dev, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:16:00) checks notes, marcus voluntarily suggesting fewer people. historic
[15] (about=Temi, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:56:00) for what it's worth Callum's been carrying more than usual lately. work's been tough on him. I don't think he'd say that here but it was obvious at the reunion dinner when he relaxed around nine and actually seemed to enjoy it. he needed that evening.
[16] (about=Temi, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:47:00) okay so I've been thinking about this, the escape room night gave me an idea for a piece. not naming anyone specifically, but the whole dynamic of adults who went to school together trying to solve problems again in a room. there's something there. what's your read Marcus

I mean the tensions, the sub-cliques, the person who almost never shows up until they do. what's your read on whether people would be okay with that

query:
One member first observed aloud that Callum was carrying more stress than usual and that his work had been difficult — framing it as something they had noticed but that Callum himself would not say in the chat. A different member in the same session agreed with this reading. Which member made the original observation about Callum's stress?

Options:
A. Omar
B. Jade
C. Temi
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:56:00) for what it's worth Callum's been carrying more than usual lately. work's been tough on him. I don't think he'd say that here but it was obvious at the reunion dinner when he relaxed around nine and actually seemed to enjoy it. he needed that evening.
[2] (about=Omar, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:59:00) yeah temi's rite bruv callum doesnt say much but you can tell. glad he came
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:40:00) right, moving on before this becomes a therapy session. Omar, what's the tournament format
[4] (about=Callum, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:54:00) not touching that one. but yes. Noted.
[5] (about=Callum, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:23:00) double-header runs long. documentary then dinner means nobody's done by nine. but that's just me
[6] (about=Callum, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:23:00) was a good night. had to leave at nine but the first part was the best part anyway, if I'm honest
[7] (about=Callum, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:14:00) kids. already an excuse, but that's just me
[8] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:35:00) Saturday was the best-attended event in two years and we did an escape room. I'll admit I would not have predicted that. good shout Jade.
[9] (about=Jade, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:25:00) Callum I love you but nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except you 😂 Temi the documentary idea is actually good. what's it about
[10] (about=Omar, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:36:00) callum I am using that quote forever bro 😂
[11] (about=Jade, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:39:00) okay but real talk, Callum thank you for saying that. genuinely. this is what the group is for!! 💙
[12] (about=Omar, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T21:04:00) callum staying past 9 is officially the comeback story of 2026 😂😂
[13] (about=Omar, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) great nite bruv 🔥 callum left at like 9:30 as usual haha
[14] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:37:00) also since we're debriefing. I almost didn't come Saturday. things have been difficult at work and I nearly texted Marcus to bail at 5pm. glad I didn't.
[15] (about=Callum, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T21:03:00) in for the 19th. setting an alarm for midnight for the first time in four years. that's just me being optimistic.
[16] (about=Temi, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:11:00) no comment. what's your read on yourself Callum
[17] (about=Dev, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:19:00) sana said three words all night but somehow still the most useful person at the table. checks notes, this is a compliment
[18] (about=Callum, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:10:00) I'm the one who almost never shows up until I do, aren't I.
[19] (about=Temi, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:47:00) okay so I've been thinking about this, the escape room night gave me an idea for a piece. not naming anyone specifically, but the whole dynamic of adults who went to school together trying to solve problems again in a room. there's something there. what's your read Marcus
[20] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:53:00) callum just voluntarily considered something new. checks notes, this is growth
[21] (about=Callum, said_by=Temi, profile, t12 @2026-04-14T19:45:00) Temi notes Callum has been carrying more than usual lately, work's been tough on him, and he needed the reunion dinner evening
[22] (about=Callum, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Callum cites having kids as an excuse for leaving early, but frames it as just his way.
[23] (about=Callum, said_by=Omar, profile, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Omar notes Callum left the pub night at around 9:30 as usual, implying a recurring early departure pattern.
[24] (about=Callum, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Callum had to leave at nine but thought the first part was the best part.
[25] (about=Jade, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Jade says nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except Callum, and thinks the documentary idea is good.
agent_answer:
**C. Temi**

Temi made the original observation: "for what it's worth Callum's been carrying more than usual lately. work's been tough on him. I don't think he'd say that here but it was obvious at the reunion dinner..." (t12 @19:56). Omar then agreed in the same session: "yeah temi's rite bruv callum doesnt say much but you can tell" (t12 @19:59).
